name: Gosfambling
description: Gosfambling was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the homeworld of the Gosfamblings. C-Gosf represented the world in the New Republic Senate.
lead_paragraphs: Gosfambling was a planet in the Mid Rim, and was the homeworld of the Gosfamblings. C-Gosf represented the world in the New Republic Senate.

Cybot Galactica stopped the production of their LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer after an incident on Gosfamnling. A detonite charge exploded while the LIN unit was handling it, causing a cave-in. Six hundred miners were trapped and suffocated to death.
